tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt ~L215-310: bootstrap ran, copied source, pre-seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md and emitted perFileMode triage (BATCH/SEQUENTIAL).

tools_problematic.problem: Recursively copies .cs from the UWP Source WITHOUT excluding bin/obj, so stale .NET-Native ILC generated sources (obj\<arch>\Release\ilc\**\*.g.cs, *.McgInterop\ImplTypes.g.cs) from the AppServicesClient/AppServicesProvider sub-projects were copied into the target tree.
tools_problematic.evidence: winui-build-first-errors.txt: CS0101/CS0227 originate from AppServicesClient/obj\x64\Release\ilc and AppServicesProvider/bin|obj\...\ilc; session-log.txt L1339-1342 shows the source obj\x6... ilc files.

tool_limitations.limitation: Step 1 copy is the only step that lacks the bin/obj/.vs/.git directory exclusion that Step 3 (namespace rewrite), Validate-UwpMigration.ps1, and Test-AppLaunch.ps1 all apply.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Apply the same $excludeDirs filter to the Step 1 copy so build output is never imported.

errors_encountered.error: dotnet build emitted 173,913 errors (CS0101 duplicate type, CS0227 unsafe code, CS0234 missing namespace) plus XAML WMC9999 internal error; build effectively hung.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Stale UWP .NET-Native ILC *.g.cs build artifacts from copied-in sub-project bin/obj were swept into the SDK-style WinUI csproj **/*.cs glob; MSBuild's default bin/obj exclusion only covers the project-root bin/obj, so nested sub-project bin/obj were still compiled.
errors_encountered.fix: Exclude bin/obj from the Step 1 copy (and delete any already-copied bin/obj from the target tree before building).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Re-ran `dotnet build` repeatedly; last invocation ran async and was still running after 600s (build1 shell). Session ended with the build unresolved — app never built or launched.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 4+ build attempts across the tail of the session; final build hung >600s
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Agent never identified that the flood of CS0101 errors traced to copied-in bin/obj ILC generated sources; it kept rebuilding the same poisoned project tree.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 not copying bin/obj in the first place (primary), plus a PATTERNS.md diagnostic entry telling the agent that a flood of CS0101/CS0227 from *\obj\...\ilc\*.g.cs means 'delete copied bin/obj'.

missing_tooling.need: Guarantee that only true source (.xaml/.cs/.resw/.appxmanifest/assets) — never build output — enters the migrated tree.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire 173k-error build break and the unrecoverable build hang.

env_issues.issue: UWP UI Automation could not enumerate the CoreWindow tree on this machine (winapp returned 0 UIA elements), so the score step's behavioral baseline for Scenario 2 was empty.
env_issues.workaround: Pixel screenshots succeeded; this is an eval/measurement (uwp-app-runner / winui3-parity-check) limitation, not a migration-skill issue — deferred to human, NOT changed here.
